purpose: Define an explicit immutable execution-context snapshot containing requester, session, project, locale, correlation, auth evidence refs and other declared contextual inputs.

value.identity_rule: Each concrete execution context has an explicit context identity or exact execution-bound snapshot identity.
value.execution_rule: Context is bound to exact request/execution.
value.fields_rule: Available context fields are explicit and typed.
value.immutability_rule: Context snapshot does not silently mutate during execution.
value.ambient_rule: Hidden ambient process/global/UI state is not canonical context.
value.authorization_rule: Authorization consumes explicit identity/evidence refs rather than trusting arbitrary context claims.
value.propagation_rule: Child operations receive only explicitly propagated context.
